title: On Teaching the children for thirty years
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：teach　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 teach 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the headmaster ① taught the children for thirty years in public, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② teaches the children for thirty years in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ teach the children for thirty years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ taught the children for thirty years before — a line in the record for October 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Teaching the children for thirty years in public, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ teach the boys to read in one year in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Teach the boys to read in one year at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ teaches the boys to read in one year in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ taught the children for thirty years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To teach the children for thirty years, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody teaches the children for thirty years in silence again and somebody must teach the children for thirty years in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 教（一般过去式 taught the children for thirty years：1955 年校长头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 教（一般现在 teaches the children for thirty years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 教（不定式 to teach the children for thirty years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 教（过去完成时 had taught the children for thirty years：1949 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 教（动名词 teaching the children for thirty years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 教会（teach the boys to read in one year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去教会一年里教会孩子们识字）
G. v. 教会（teach the boys to read in one year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 教（后段两处：新来的学生照例 teaches the boys to read in one year，而母亲又一次 taught the children for thirty years）

answers.why: teach 意为“教”，1955 年校长当着众人面教教了那些孩子三十年，那是学堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 taught。
teach 意为“教”，自那以后校长一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 teaches。
teach 意为“教”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯教教了那些孩子三十年”，此处为不定式 to teach the children for thirty years。
teach 意为“教”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人教过，故用过去完成时 had taught。
teach 意为“教”，校长说“教教了那些孩子三十年这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 teaching the children for thirty years 作主语。
teach 意为“教会”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去教会一年里教会孩子们识字”，should ever 之后用原形 teach the boys to read in one year。
teach 意为“教会”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻教会一年里教会孩子们识字（teach the boys to read in one year at once），以后再也不要提起。
teach 意为“教”，新来的学生每个学年都照例教会一年里教会孩子们识字，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 teaches。
teach 意为“教”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面教教了那些孩子三十年，用一般过去式 taught 叙述。
teach 意为“教”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要教教了那些孩子三十年，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 teach 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the headmaster taught the children for thirty years in public, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster teaches the children for thirty years in silence whenever the school asks.
Teaching the children for thirty years in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever teach the boys to read in one year in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school teaches the boys to read in one year in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother taught the children for thirty years again, and the school remembered that half.
